'''2010 Malastare Regionals Stephen Morgan LS Plead My Case To The Senate''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Stephen Morgan]] at [[2010 Malastare Regionals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Plead My Case To The Senate / Sanity And Compassion|Cor-L-pleadmycasetothesenate.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' Rebel Senators From Georgia
* '''Username:''' Stephen1185
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
